 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Karolina Muchova has withdrawn from today's round-robin match against Mirra Andreeva at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells with what is being described as a "gastrointestinal illness."
 She will be replaced in the match by second alternate Diana Shnaider who will now face Andreeva. Luckily for the tournament, the Muchova-Andreeva was meaningless in the sense that it did not have an effect on who advances to Saturday's semifinals.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Andreeva has already clinched the top spot in the group and Muchova had already been eliminated. The other two competitors in the group, Aryna Sabalenka and Elina Svitolina, will play each other this afternoon with the winner getting the final spot in the semifinals.
 "Unfortunately, I have to withdraw from today's match due to gastrointestinal issues," Muchova said. "It's not how I wanted to end my season, but there's a lot to be proud of and I'm already looking forward to next year."
 Karolina Muchova returns to Aryna Sabalenka during the WTA Finals second day round robin at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden in Indian Wells, Calif., on Mon., Nov. 9, 2026. While the Andreeva-Shnaider match will not matter in the standings the winner will receive $230,000 so there is still motivation for both.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The other group has already finished round-robin play and Linda Noskova and Jessica Pegula have advanced to the semifinals which will be played Saturday with the finals on Sunday.
